Clip Path Generator

Draw a polygon by clicking points on a box and get the matching clip-path CSS with a live preview.

Tip: click points around the outline of the shape you want, in order.

📖 How to use

  1. Click anywhere on the canvas to add polygon points (in order).
  2. Use Undo / Clear, or load a preset shape.
  3. Watch the colored box update live as you draw.
  4. Copy the clip-path CSS or download it, then paste it onto any element.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add points?

Click on the dotted canvas. Each click adds a vertex in the order you click. Three or more points form a polygon.

Can I remove a single point?

Use Undo to remove the most recently added point, or Clear to start over.

What units does the output use?

Percentages of the element box (x% y%), so the shape scales with any element size.

Why does my shape look wrong?

Points connect in click order — click around the outline of the shape you want, clockwise or counter-clockwise.
